name: Terrarium 90x50x50
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 90x50x50 cm. Volume: 225.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 90x50x50 cm terrarium has 4500 cm² of floor and 225 liters. Without a 3D background all 50 cm of depth is left to the animal. Its floor area equals that of the 100x45 model, but it is 10 cm shorter and 5 cm wider. The height is also 50 cm, so the cross-section is square.

An adult ball python has permanent housing here: a wide floor for two large hides and height for a thick branch. An adult corn snake uses both the length and the height. Tortoises get almost half a square meter of floor. For an adult bearded dragon the length is 10 cm below the recommended minimum, so if you are choosing for one, take the 100x50x50.

We build the same cross-section in lengths of 80 and 100 cm as standard models. Film of your choice goes on the back and sides. If you want a 3D background or another size, the build takes 7 to 14 days. We ship the finished terrarium by courier, and because of the 90 cm length, prepare its place in advance.
